approach: Matching decompilation with GCC 2.95.2 (USA) and GCC 2.8.1 (Japan, Europe), splat and maspsx, byte-identical for all three releases from one source tree
help: Naming functions, data and struct fields
Replacing the last fake matches with natural C
notes: Every game function is C in all three releases, the executable and the overlays: 1,370 functions in the USA one, 1,191 in the Japanese one and 1,598 in the European one. The game's data is C too, and each release rebuilds byte for byte, checked against the SHA-1 of every original binary. The PsyQ libraries are Sony's code, not the game's, and are left out of the progress. Readability work continues: names, comments and cleaner C. 7 functions still match through a fake match, each marked in the source and listed in TODO.md.
